Variable widths and connected branches replace radial clouds. Samples stay on present land, outside selected coarse wetland/delta cores and off the central river channel. This is a habitable-area proxy, not a DEM, climate/wetland inventory, surveyed historic settlement boundary, resident census or claim that a named group occupied every point. Widths, guide belts and exclusions are display assumptions; people totals and chronology are unchanged.

O4-SOUTHAFRICA.basis: Irregular geographic display reconstruction follows retained Natural Earth river-valley and coastal approaches, supplemented by explicitly reconstructed lowland/foothill/settled-water-access guide belts. Variable widths and connected branches replace radial clouds. Samples stay on present land, outside selected coarse wetland/delta cores and off the central river channel. This is a habitable-area proxy, not a DEM, climate/wetland inventory, surveyed historic settlement boundary, resident census or claim that a named group occupied every point. Widths, guide belts and exclusions are display assumptions; people totals and chronology are unchanged.

basis: Separate dated source/cohort priors fund every transfer. Zero natural growth prevents unobserved births being silently inferred from an earlier migration flow. Later-generation source baselines are declared explicitly, not asserted to be census-complete or exact individual survival histories. Adjacent linked transfers debit their parent destination. Low-flow scenario retains the central source prior with lower outflow; high source priors are a separately declared funding sensitivity, not source censuses. Low/central/high are visualization scenarios, not confidence intervals. Unknown source populations remain null. Source flows, resident stocks, mortality, genetic ancestry and modern descendants are different counting units. Source-free allocations are explicitly illustrative, never measured censuses.
